description: Expected outcomes for the gatebraid/gate-run@2 fixture set. Every expectation below was MEASURED against the frozen schemas with CPython 3.12.2 / jsonschema 4.23.0 and recorded from that run, not asserted from reading. An invalid case names the EXACT AND COMPLETE set of (keyword, path) loci: the runner requires every recorded locus to fire and rejects any locus that fires but was not recorded. A fixture rejected for the wrong reason is not a kill, and an over-mutated fixture that fails for four reasons while the corpus records one is a defect the corpus must surface rather than absorb.
